description_en: Updates the minor version of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
description_zh: 升级云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的小版本
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore modify-instance-minor-version --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --minorversion latest_version --effective-time Immediately --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceMinorVersion

parameters.description_en: The minor version to which you want to update. Default value: **latest_version**.
parameters.description_zh: 要升级到的小版本，默认值：**latest_version**，即最新版本。
parameters.help_en: The minor version to which you want to update. Default value: **latest_version**
parameters.help_zh: 要升级到的小版本，默认值：**latest_version**，即最新版本
parameters.name: minorversion

parameters.description_en:
The time when you want to update the minor version. Valid values:

*   **Immediately** (default): immediately updates the minor version.
*   **MaintainTime**: updates the minor version during the maintenance window.

>  You can call the [ModifyInstanceMaintainTime](~~473775~~) operation to modify the maintenance window of an instance.
parameters.description_zh:
升级执行时间，取值：
* **Immediately**：立即执行，默认值。
* **MaintainTime**：在可维护时间段执行。

> 您可以调用[ModifyInstanceMaintainTime](~~473775~~)修改实例的可维护时间段。
